quote: Our framework implements a fully end-to-end Action Prediction strategy that directly generates navigation commands in natural language form.
Our MapNav agent uses the constructed ASM as input, harnessing the powerful end-to-end capabilities of VLM to enhance vision-and-language navigation.
outputs: navigation commands in natural language (e.g., 'move forward', 'turn left', 'stop')
executable navigation actions in text format

quote: Metrics. We utilize several widely used evaluation metrics for VLN tasks: Navigation Error (NE), Oracle Success rate (OS), Success Rate (SR), Success weighted Path Length (SPL), and normalized Dynamic Temporal Wrapping (nDTW).
